newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ING Barings ups Argentina's YPF to buy from hold.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings ups Argentina's YPF to buy from hold.

text.p: ING Barings said Thursday it upgraded Argentine oil company YPF SA to buy from hold.

"We are upgrading YPF to BUY from HOLD based on improved fundamentals for the downstream segment, our recent upward revision on oil prices forecasts, the recent correction of the stock and increased visibility after being rated investment grade," analyst Hernan Ladeuix wrote in a report.
He added ING was also very positive on YPF's medium term fundamentals, especially in natural gas.

"We are increasing our 1997 and 1998 EPS estimates from $2.24 and $2.46 to $2.57 and $2.74 respectively ... (and) setting a new 12-month price target of $39 per share", that implies a potential appreciation of 33 percent from current levels.
